Line 9 = 30,000.00 - 8,595.00 = 21,405.00. Line 10a 1 x 700 = 700.00; line 10b 0 x 250 = 0.00; line 10c 700.00. Line 11 taxable income = 21,405.00 - 700.00 = 20,705.00. Line 12 tax, Schedule C (separate) as numbers: 3.5% x 9,790.00 = 342.65 + 4.4% x 10,915.00 = 480.26; total 822.91, rounded once to 822.91.
